title: What's new in {{version}}
intro: A few changes worth knowing about:
items: You can now see who else is looking at this character sheet right now: the history header shows "DM is here" or "Player was active 3 min ago".
Shared change history is now more reliable: entries no longer have a cap and won't get lost during an active shared session.
On the DM's shared updates screen, change history can now be expanded per character instead of loading everything at once.
